## What

A short description of the change and why.

## How to test

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run fmt:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if you touched the CLI, daemon, or e2e setup)

If you changed Rust:

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`

Any manual smoke you ran (command, harness, OS):

## Notes

- Issue this closes, if any (for example `Closes #123`):
- User-visible change: I added a bullet under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, or this does not need one.
- Tests: I added or updated tests, or I am explaining why not.
- Affiliation: I work on or have an interest in a registry, product, or harness this PR adds (write it here, or "none").
